svg.title: Governed Operational Reasoning Flow
svg.desc: Evidence-constrained workflow for LTDD determination and audit-defensible documentation support.
svg.text: Evidence-constrained workflow for LTDD determination and audit-defensible documentation support.
Potential LTDD event identified · initial facts documented
INVESTIGATION GATE · facts separated before proceeding
VALIDATION GATE · unsupported claims blocked before proceeding
Unsupported claims blocked · evidence gaps identified
GOVERNANCE GATE · escalation conditions reviewed before proceeding
Identify rejection risks and escalation conditions
GENERATION GATE · only supported facts proceed to draft
Uncertainty explicitly preserved · disposal unconfirmed until documented
Review for unsupported reasoning and evidence gaps
Behavior and evidence rules are applied independently at each reasoning stage.
